info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: catalog returns the canonical public benchmark set the arena runs.
get.description:
catalog returns the canonical public benchmark set the arena runs.
That is the top-14 every major provider reports, under one standardized harness.
Static registry data: no measurement is read.

get.summary: compare runs the ONLY valid arm-vs-arm test, paired on a common item set.
get.description:
compare runs the ONLY valid arm-vs-arm test, paired on a common item set. It
reports each arm's rescues over the other on the items BOTH models completed, plus
an exact two-sided McNemar p. Pairing is what prevents the subset artifact — one
model's easy subset scored against another's full run.

parameters.name: benchmark
parameters.description: Benchmark is a catalog benchmark id; empty means gpqa_diamond.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: A is the first model id. Required.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: B is the second model id. Required.

get.summary: leaderboard aggregates one benchmark's measured attempts per model and layers the
get.description:
leaderboard aggregates one benchmark's measured attempts per model and layers the
provider-published claim beside them, coverage-aware and never blended: gap is
published − measured, and a model with only one of the two planes shows null for
the other.

parameters.name: benchmark
parameters.description: Benchmark is a catalog benchmark id; empty means gpqa_diamond.

get.summary: presets lists the router blends available to the caller.
get.description:
presets lists the router blends available to the caller. Today that is the single
built-in reference blend — user presets do not persist yet — so it is the worked
example to fork, not an enumeration of anyone's saved blends.

data.name: ultra
data.note: example blend; fork it and swap arms by your measured leaderboard.

post.summary: createPreset validates a router blend and answers 202 with its enso-<name> id.
post.description:
createPreset validates a router blend and answers 202 with its enso-<name> id. Every
rank entry must resolve to a declared arm; panel below 1 is raised to 1 and an empty
rank defaults to the arms order. Nothing is persisted yet — the enso serving layer
resolves the blend.

post.summary: queueRun admits and queues a measurement run, answering 202.
post.description:
queueRun admits and queues a measurement run, answering 202. The target is a
catalog model or a BYO OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Every benchmark id is validated
against the catalog first, so an unknown id is rejected rather than silently
dropped. Execution is the async worker; nothing is measured on this call.

data.description: Data is every benchmark in the catalog, in registry order.

total.description: Total is how many benchmarks the catalog holds.

a.description: A and B are the two model ids compared.

a_correct.description: ACorrect and BCorrect are each arm's correct count on the common set.

benchmark.description: Benchmark is the benchmark both arms were measured on.

mcnemar_p.description: McnemarP is the two-sided exact McNemar p over the discordant pairs.

n_common.description: NCommon is how many items BOTH arms completed — the only valid denominator.

rescue_a_over_b.description: RescueAOverB is items A got right and B got wrong; RescueBOverA the reverse.

gap.description: Gap is published − measured, the arena signal. Null unless both planes exist.

measured.description: Measured is the hanzo-measured accuracy %, null when the model was not run.

model.description: Model is the model id the row aggregates.

n.description: N is the coverage (items measured) — NEVER compare rows across different n.

protocol.description: Protocol is how the provider scored their claim (single-attempt/pass@k/agentic).

published.description: Published is the provider-claimed %, null when no claim is on file.

benchmark.description: Benchmark is the benchmark the rows were aggregated for.

rows.description: Rows is one row per model, sorted by measured accuracy descending.

arms.description: Arms is the blend — model ids from the arena.

name.description: Name is the blend's name; it is served as enso-<name>.

note.description: Note records why this blend was authored (audit).

owner.description: Owner is the scoping org (never cross-tenant).

panel.description: Panel is the fan-out width (>= 1); below 1 it is raised to 1.

rank.description: Rank is the escalation order over arms; empty means the arms order.

note.description: Note states where the blend is resolved.

preset.description: Preset is the normalized preset (panel raised to >= 1, rank defaulted to arms).

served_as.description: ServedAs is the model id the enso serving layer resolves this blend under.

data.description: Data is every preset visible to the caller.

benchmarks.description: Benchmarks echoes the admitted benchmark ids.

model.description: Model and Endpoint echo the admitted target.

note.description: Note states the caching rule the runner applies.

attempts.description: Attempts caps how many items to attempt; 0 means the whole benchmark.

benchmarks.description: Benchmarks is the catalog benchmark ids to run. At least one is required.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint is a BYO OpenAI-compatible base URL to measure instead of a
catalog model.

model.description: Model is the model id to measure. Required unless Endpoint is given.
